vBRIEFInfo.description: Harden pr:merge-ready to gate on GitHub CI check-run conclusions on the primary/fallback1 paths, not just Greptile (#2169).

plan.title: harden(pr:merge-ready): gate on CI check-run conclusions

narratives.Description: task pr:merge-ready computes MERGE-READY purely from the Greptile parse (HEAD-SHA, confidence, P0/P1/P2). It does not consult GitHub CI check-run conclusions on the primary/fallback1 paths, so a red required CI check + clean Greptile reports MERGE-READY. fetchCheckRunsRest exists but is only used in the degraded fallback2 diagnostics path. Add required-check-run gating to the primary/fallback1 verdict.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. In packages/core/src/pr-merge-readiness/compute.ts, after the Greptile gate passes on primary/fallback1, fetch check-runs for HEAD SHA (fetchCheckRunsRest in gh.ts) and fail MERGE-READY when any REQUIRED check-run conclusion is failure/cancelled/timed_out. Treat in_progress/queued as a distinct NOT-READY-yet state (not a hard fail). 2. Surface a CI summary line in the human output block (CI check-runs: <n passed>/<m failed>/<k pending>); include check-run conclusions in --json. 3. Documented escape hatch (--skip-ci or allow-list for known-flaky NON-required checks); required checks fail closed by default. 4. Extend the cohort verifier (scripts/verify-review-clean.ts or packages equivalent, task swarm:verify-review-clean) to inherit the same CI gate (share the parser/gate per #1364 lockstep). 5. Tests: green-CI+clean-Greptile=ready; red-required-CI+clean-Greptile=not-ready; pending-CI=not-ready-yet; flaky-non-required=escape honored. Run task check GREEN. CHANGELOG [Unreleased] ### Fixed entry.
narratives.UserStory: As an operator relying on pr:merge-ready in the cascade, I want a red required CI check to block MERGE-READY even when Greptile is clean, so an admin squash-merge cannot land a red-CI commit.

items.title: Required check-run failure blocks MERGE-READY on primary/fallback1

narrative.Acceptance: pr:merge-ready reports NOT-READY when a required check-run on HEAD is failure/cancelled/timed_out; READY only when required checks green AND Greptile clean.

items.title: Pending checks yield NOT-READY-yet (distinct from fail)

narrative.Acceptance: in_progress/queued required checks produce a distinct not-ready-yet state, not a hard fail.
Human output shows a CI summary line; --json includes conclusions; a documented --skip-ci / non-required allow-list escape hatch exists.

items.title: Cohort verifier inherits the CI gate

narrative.Acceptance: swarm:verify-review-clean shares the same CI gate (lockstep per #1364).
Tests cover ready / red-required / pending / flaky-non-required; task check passes; CHANGELOG entry added.
